lines.text: You missed this call. Because you were literally... under a sink.
And they're OFF! In lane one, the plumber... still elbow-deep in a pipe!
But in lane two, the text-back bot! Text sent! Question asked! Job... BOOKED!
IT'S OVER! The bot takes it! What a finish!
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Missed calls... texted back, automatically. DM us the word CALL. And remember, you're still the captain.
